summary: National Bank Holdings Corp filed an 8-K to declare a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per Class A common share, payable on June 15, 2026 to holders of record on May 29, 2026. The filing is a routine announcement of a regular dividend, not a special situation in the realm of M&A or other corporate events. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other special-situation trigger is present. The board retains discretion over future dividends based on financial position and legal requirements. This is an ordinary capital allocation action with no risk-arb or event-driven angle.
